newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Napocor sees 1996 profits up 5.13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Napocor sees 1996 profits up 5.13 pct.

text.p: State-owned Philippine National Power Corp (Napocor) said it sees its 1996 full-year net income up by 5.13 percent at 4.1 billion pesos from 3.9 billion pesos in 1995, a top Napocor official said.
Napocor president Guido A. Delgado told reporters on Friday that gross revenue was expected to reach 63 billion pesos in 1996, 20.22 percent higher than 1995's 52.4 billion pesos.

Delgado said the projections were based on the power firm's 11-month sales performance in 1996. Energy sales of Napocor from January to November rose 7.5 percent at 30,598 gigawatt-hours from 28,463 GWHs.
Napocor's net utility revenue was already 19.32 percent higher from January to November last year at 57.545 billion pesos from 48.227 billion pesos in 1995, Delgado added.
For the 11-month period, total energy generation amounted to 32,583 GWH, 6.6 percent higher than 1995's 30,565 GWHs.
Total energy generation for the entire 1996 is projected to reach almost 36,000 Gwhs, nine percent higher than the 33,300 GWHs the previous year.
Delgado said Napocor was projected to post a net operating income of 12 billion pesos against 11.5 billion pesos in 1995.
Operating expenses of the utility are expected to increase to 51 billion pesos in 1996 from 41 billion pesos the previous year, he said.
